Methods

9 studies were pooled by inverse-variance weighting on the log scale and back-transformed, with the standard error of each study derived from its 95% confidence interval or given directly. The fixed-effect estimate of hazard_ratio was 0.763 (95% CI 0.703 to 0.827, P = 7.1e-11), and the DerSimonian-Laird random-effects estimate was 0.766 (95% CI 0.699 to 0.839, P = 1.1e-08). Heterogeneity was assessed with Cochran’s Q (Q = 9.64, df = 8, P = 0.29), I2 = 17.0% and tau2 = 0.0033. Squares are sized by the random-effects weight and the diamonds show the pooled estimates. Computed in Python 3.10.12 with statsmodels 0.15.0 (combine_effects) and drawn with matplotlib 3.10.9.
